access_review.notes: A manual/browser snapshot on 2026-09-07 confirmed that the public homepage is directly browser-accessible and exposes program-oriented navigation and current publication links. The indexed homepage surface did not expose identifiable About, Contact, Terms, Privacy or Copyright text. Search did not surface a first-party policy page, and robots.txt could not be independently verified in this research run. Absence from the indexed surface is not evidence that no policy exists, so terms_reviewed/robots_reviewed/api_policy_reviewed remain false.

rights_review.notes: Do not copy or retain program images/media. A public page being readable is not evidence of permission for automated reuse, text normalization, media retention or republication. No first-party reuse/license statement was identified in this research run.

provenance_review.rationale: The site is highly domain-relevant and visibly active, but operator authority, upstream source provenance, editorial correction practices and reuse permissions have not yet been established.
